extraction.name: TextVQA
extraction.description: A Visual Question Answering dataset containing 45,336 questions on 28,408 images that require reading and reasoning about text in the images to answer.
extraction.creator: Amanpreet Singh, Vivek Natarajan, Meet Shah, Yu Jiang, Xinlei Chen, Dhruv Batra, Devi Parikh, Marcus Rohrbach
extraction.rai:dataCollection: A three-stage crowdsourcing pipeline on images sampled from categories in Open Images v3 that tend to contain text (weighted using the Rosetta OCR system). In the first stage, annotators filtered out images without text using a forced-choice flag. In the second stage, annotators generated 1-2 questions per image requiring reading text to answer. In the third stage, 10 human answers were collected for each question.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionType: User-generated content data, Manual Human Curator
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: Open Images v3 dataset (training and test sets)
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Images were sampled based on OCR box frequency per category and filtered to exclude images without text or noisy annotator submissions. Questions were discarded if a majority of workers flagged them as having no text in image, not being a question, not requiring reading text, or being unanswerable. Hand-crafted test questions with known answers were used to filter out low-quality annotators.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Crowdsourced annotators generated questions that required reading text in images and provided answers. For the second question per image, annotators were shown the first question and instructed to ask a new question requiring text reasoning with a different answer. Sighted annotators supplied 10 open-ended answers per question.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis: All 10 annotators agreed on the most common answer for 22.8% of questions, while 3 or more annotators agreed on the most common answer for 97.9% of questions. Questions flagged by a majority of workers as invalid or unanswerable were removed.
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: Aims to advance assistive technology for visually impaired users, who frequently ask questions involving reading and reasoning about text in their surroundings.
extraction.rai:dataBiases: Most questions start with 'what' and frequently inquire about common things like time, names, brands, or authors. The model demonstrates a tendency to answer city-related questions with 'new york'. Question-only and image-only baseline analyses show the dataset does not have significant unimodal biases w.r.t. images and questions.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: 8.9% of TextVQA questions require combining multiple OCR tokens to answer, which models limited to single-token copying cannot address. Relies on the quality of underlying OCR systems, which struggle with rotated, unstructured, or occluded text.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Training, validation, and testing of Visual Question Answering (VQA) models that read and reason about text embedded in everyday images.
